body:
## What it does

Reasons from first principles and refuses to hand back an answer with an unverified source without saying so, which is the difference between research and a confident paragraph. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @ArthurMacwaters shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
